protocol.block_definition: consecutive same-label trials in subject time order (canonical rows of dense cache give trial id; label-run count = 339, same as causal_kernel_state_mapping switch definition)
protocol.train_test: train = canonical non-overlapping 6 s windows of the same subject from other blocks; test = held-out block; no dense windows used, so no train window overlaps the test block in time
protocol.skip_rule: block-folds whose remaining blocks contain only one class are skipped (those windows unscored)

models.cnn: grouped-conv 1D CNN (8/16/16 ch, k25s2/9/9, GAP), AdamW lr2e-3 wd1e-3, 400 steps, balanced batch 32, per-window demean + train-block std scaling, seed 0
models.mean3: mean of three probabilities (pre-specified, not selected)

quality_factors.flat_or_bad_frac: windows with >=25-sample zero-diff run or std >6 MAD from median or std~0
quality_factors.max_abs_cohen_d: max |Cohen d| R vs T over the 16 features (uses labels, diagnostic)
